# public-owned-paths.txt — freeze guard list (C4).
# Every path below now lives in TogetherWeOwn/paperclip-operator-toolkit.
# Generated from vendor/toolkit-files.txt (dest side, pinned main-533c7ae2) minus
# still-tracked private survivors and plugins/model-selection/ (covered by
# the model-selection-moved guard). Do not edit by hand: re-generate with
#   cut -d'|' -f1 vendor/toolkit-files.txt | sort -u | grep -v '^plugins/model-selection/' | comm -23 - <(comm -12 <(git ls-tree -r --name-only origin/main | sort -u) <(git ls-files | sort -u))
# and keep sorted. CI fails any PR that adds/modifies these paths.
# CI runs the same recipe against the PR base SHA (not the PR tree), so
# re-adding a listed path cannot drop it from the list to bypass the guard,
# and deleting a survivor picks it up instead of failing drift.
#
